messages:
elaine: kicking off geo-aware canary for v2.14.1 in the 01:00-03:00 change window. plan: split cohorts by region (NA=1%, EU=0.5%) with feature flag `new-ranking` enabled for canary traffic only. rolling ramp: NA 1% -> 4% -> 15%; EU 0.5% -> 3% -> 10%. will pin fallback to v2.13.6 if needed. deploy-bot will post checkpoints. pls monitor latencies and error rates :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for v2.14.1 (sha: f9e8d7c). Canary cohorts: NA=1% (new-ranking=on), EU=0.5% (new-ranking=on). Smoke tests queued. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14.1/notes

samir: fyi seeing elevated tail latency from EU routing at ~4m. sample trace shows retry loop hitting the downstream scorer. trace excerpt: ```trace_id=0xabc status=retry count=3 downstream_latency_ms=420```

devops-jen: hm. could be regional capacity pressure. recommend: 1) hold EU ramp, 2) enable per-region circuit-breaker threshold to fallback to v2.13.6 at 0.7% errors, 3) increase scorer concurrency for EU canary nodes by +10% temporarily

maya: agree on hold. also propose toggling `new-ranking` to 20% of canary requests (i.e., internal sampling) for EU to reduce load while keeping signal. we can use runtime flag `new-ranking-sample=0.2`

elaine: good call. implementing changes: hold EU ramp, set `new-ranking-sample=0.2` for EU canary, request scorer concurrency bump. pin runtime holdpoint so no further automated ramp until manual ACK. updating release notes blurb: "EU canary sampling reduced; NA canary continuing."

deploy-bot: Actions recorded: EU ramp paused, set `canary_hold=true` for EU, toggled `new-ranking-sample=0.2` for EU canary, and queued infra change for scorer concurrency increase. Rollback runbook: https://internal.ops/runbooks/v2.14.1-rollback

oncall-bot: ALERT: EU canary error rate approaching threshold (threshold=0.7%). current=0.66% (1m avg). paging: samir, devops-jen

samir: watching logs and evals. if error_rate >=0.7% for 2m -> immediate actions: 1) flip `new-ranking` to 0% for EU cohort 2) route EU canary to v2.13.6 3) run smoke and quick eval set to compare ranking quality

devops-jen: scorer concurrency bump applied to EU canary nodes. command: ```infractl node update --region eu --pool canary --scorer-concurrency +10%``` monitoring for 3m

maya: starting quick evals against EU prompt set to ensure sampling doesn't degrade signal. will post pass/fail and top-k differences.

elaine: holding NA ramp to next checkpoint until EU stabilizes. if EU improves in 10m we'll resume NA ramp to 4%. keeping everyone listed in release notes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: after concurrency bump and sampling, EU 3m avg error_rate dropped to 0.45%. EU canary remains at sampled `new-ranking`=20%. NA canary cleared to proceed to 4% per plan. Continuing to monitor metrics and record checkpoints.
